title: sarcocapnos baetica
intro: Sarcocapnos baetica, commonly known as the Spanish catchfly or false gentian, is a flowering plant belonging to the Papaveraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Sarcocapnos baetica include alkaloids, particularly protopine, which is responsible for its medicinal properties.
